notes.title: Release Date Announced!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! 

The Widow's Boutique is launching on March 8th, on the International Women's Day. We see this as a good launch date for a game about a woman in business in the 1820´s!

Make sure to wishlist the game so you can be notified when it's out!
